summary.text: Nick Marshall is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Chris Garten.
He grew up in the foster care system and says he wants to be a voice for children in the child welfare system.

paragraphs.text: Nick Marshall earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Louisville in 2016.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was the first person in his family to graduate from college.
He also said teachers played a pivotal role in his life and that he wants better pay raises for teachers and equal resources for all Hoosier schools.
Marshall ran against Garten in the 2022 general election for the same seat and lost.
